_comment: founder-content-writer per-project config. Copied to <your-projects-root>/<project>/founder-content-writer/config.json on the first run. language: the founder's language when project-context does not say it (null: voice pack, then context.json, then the raw material). address: null keeps the default of assets/voice-defaults.json (French posts use vous); tu or vous overrides it. networks: default networks of a post, linkedin and x. posts_per_batch: how many posts a batch aims for when the material allows it; never padded. x_allow_thread: false keeps X to one tweet of 280 weighted characters; true also needs x_allow_thread in content-publisher's queue settings. allowed_names: tools, places or other names the posts may use without a cited passage. Optional: a "tools" object (same keys as shared/tools.example.json, for example {"critic": "builtin", "copy_lint": "local", "transcription": "manual"}) overrides the project's tools.json for this agent.
